toml:
# 60-minute GPS-denied gravity-map-matching benchmark on the REAL gravity field (WP-10, RM-17).
#
# Every parameter is `gps-denied-gravity-nav.toml`'s, unchanged: the same track, drift,
# gravimeter, map sigma, search and noise seed. The synthetic trend and mascons are replaced by
# the gravity anomaly synthesised from the bundled EGM2008 coefficients to degree 70 (WGS84,
# zero-degree term on). That synthesis is checked against the ICGEM Calculation Service to
# about 1e-8 mGal (tests/icgem_gravity_anomaly_oracle.rs). The navigation outcome has no
# external oracle. Its bars and the prediction were pre-registered in
# xval/icgem-egm2008/PREREGISTRATION.md before the first run; the outcome is in RESULTS.md
# there.
#
# Degree 70 resolves features no shorter than about 285 km (half-wavelength), much smoother
# than the synthetic mascons (sigma about 30 km), so the drift is only weakly observable.

# Dispatched by the scenario engine as `kind = "gravity-map"`.
kind = "gravity-map"

# Unused when `reference` is set (the synthetic field is replaced); kept at the benchmark value.
nmax = 3

# Track flown GPS-denied: 90 waypoints, 40 s gravimeter averaging each ⇒ 3600 s = 60 min.
# An oblique leg keeps the scalar gravimeter sequence observable in both north and east.
start_lat_deg = 10.0
start_lon_deg = 20.0
step_lat_deg = 0.06
step_lon_deg = 0.045
waypoints = 90

# True constant INS position drift accumulated over the one-hour outage (≈ 70 km at ~13° lat,
# i.e. far past the 10 km the matched solution must beat).
drift_lat_deg = 0.5
drift_lon_deg = -0.4

# Cold-atom gravimeter: 1e-7 m/s²/√Hz ASD (≈10 µGal/√Hz), 40 s averaging ⇒ σ ≈ 1.6e-3 mGal.
gravimeter_asd = 1.0e-7
averaging_time_s = 40.0

# Map/representation error (mGal): combined with the sensor white noise into the matching σ.
map_sigma_mgal = 2.0

# Hierarchical offset search: ±0.8° at 0.08° to start, then three coarse-to-fine stages each
# shrinking the window and step 8× ⇒ final offset resolution 0.08° / 8² ≈ 140 m.
search_half_deg = 0.8
search_step_deg = 0.08
refine_stages = 3
refine_factor = 8.0
noise_seed = 1

# The real reference field: bundled EGM2008, degree 70, sampled on a 0.02 deg grid.
[reference]
model = "egm2008"
nmax = 70
ellipsoid = "wgs84"
zero_degree = true
grid_step_deg = 0.02
summary: gravity-map | free-inertial drift 70607 m | gravity-matched 3106 m | matching sigma 2.000e0 mGal | reference degree 70 anomaly std 9.8 mGal
